goal: The Pi Lane edit guard laneEditRefusal lives in the dependency-free runtime module runtime/unattended/lane_workspace.ts, so tests/unattended-batch-lanes.test.ts loads no Pi extension and passes in a node_modules-free materialized delivery clone, which unblocks the batch integration check for every child whose acceptance runs that file.

acceptance.assertion: laneEditRefusal is exported from plugins/immune-brain/runtime/unattended/lane_workspace.ts with unchanged behavior: an edit or write from inside a Lane to a path outside it is refused with the existing text, and a non-edit tool, an in-Lane path or a non-Lane cwd yields null; the Pi tool_call handler in imm-canary-work.ts still blocks with that refusal.

tests/unattended-batch-lanes.test.ts imports no module under plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension and no package resolved from node_modules, so it passes in a depth-1 Git clone of the delivery tree that has no node_modules directory.
